objective: Adaptively test whether short gold-suffix closure supervision preserves the useful recall direction of first-divergence repair without its repeated-boundary cascade.

study_scope.prior_result_used_for_method_design: The on-policy endpoint changed 14 of 220 open rows, gained three true positives, and added 18 false positives; source row 187 alone added 15 false positives by generating boundaries 1 through 16.

training_data.reuse_disclosure: Reuse the same 96 rows selected by the locked on-policy repair schedule; these rows and their preceding benchmark outcome are no longer untouched.

greedy_mining.timing: Generate all 96 selected rows from frozen checkpoint 16 before the first optimizer update.
greedy_mining.actionable_row: The recovered prediction must contain at least one boundary absent from gold and must have a concrete first token divergence from the gold continuation.
greedy_mining.repair_prefix: The exact checkpoint-16 generated token prefix before the first divergence.
greedy_mining.invalid_or_non_false_positive_outputs: Audit and skip without a gradient.

intervention.loss: Pairwise softplus(wrong_logit - correct_logit + 0.5) at the first divergence plus 0.25 times teacher-forced CE on at most the next three gold tokens after the corrective token.
intervention.post_step_proximal_rule: After each AdamW step, replace theta by checkpoint16 + 0.995 * (theta - checkpoint16).

materialization.rule: Use the single locked update-6 endpoint unchanged.

evaluation.source: The same 220 open publisher-TRAIN-derived scene development rows used to diagnose the preceding failure.

stopping_rule: Archive, commit, and push all outcomes. This adaptive study cannot authorize publisher validation, publisher test, Hard32, or the unused 73-row strength holdout.
